cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Cloud Analytics - Software Development Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
In this role responsibilities include, although not limited to:
Develops applications that work in and on industry or hybrid cloud environments using capabilities and frameworks from internal and external cloud providers. Develops and coordinates cloud architecture over various areas, including application development, identity and access management, network and data management, and security. Defines the initial DevSec Ops solution and links it to the cloud platform. Utilizes DevOps processes, automation, culture, and target platforms. Leverages expertise in cloud platforms including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Azure, building and designing web services in the cloud, orchestrating and automating cloud-based platforms, as well as frontend development of the user interface that typically run over various form factors including mobile and PC. Utilizes HTML, JavaScript libraries, responsive, and/or AWS frameworks.
cond_0001.requirements:

Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or related field and 1+ years of experience -OR- a master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or related field
1+ Years of experience in one or more of the following: C, C++, C#/Java, .NET, Python, Object-Oriented Programming, CI/CD tools, scripting tools, and DevOps
1+ Years of experience in containers, serverless, streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, etc.), distributed systems design (SOA/microservices) concepts, and capabilities
Preferred Requirements
1+ Years of experience building data engineering pipelines with MPP databases (for example AWS RedShift, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, Teradata), Lambda architecture design, database design, data modeling, Big Data Cloud (for example SPARK, Splunk, NoSQL), advanced analytics, AI/ML infrastructure solutions
2+ Years of experience in large-scale software development/integration especially in Big Data/AI/ML
Ability to work in environments with competing and alternating priorities, with a constant focus on timely delivery
Excellent communication, problem-solving and analytical skills with a focus on finding creative solutions to challenging technical problems
A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to take on challenging technical projects and drive them to completion
Systematic problem solving, proven track records of meeting and beating commitments
Decision making and problem solving, tolerance to ambiguity

cond_0060.intro: We are looking for a Cloud Analytics - Software Development Engineer to join our team.
cond_0060.responsibilities:
A large part of this role involves working closely with teams across application development, identity and access management, network and data management, and security to develop and coordinate cloud architecture. You will regularly connect with stakeholders to define DevSecOps solutions and link them to the cloud platform.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Develop applications that work in industry or hybrid cloud environments using capabilities and frameworks from internal and external cloud providers.
Coordinate cloud architecture across multiple areas, staying in active communication with teams covering application development, identity and access management, network and data management, and security.
Define the initial DevSecOps solution and link it to the cloud platform.
Apply DevOps processes, automation, culture, and target platforms.
Work with cloud platforms including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Azure — building and designing web services in the cloud, orchestrating and automating cloud-based platforms, and developing frontend user interfaces that run across mobile and PC form factors.
Use HTML, JavaScript libraries, responsive, and/or AWS frameworks.
cond_0060.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or related field with 1+ years of experience — OR — a master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or related field.
1+ Years of experience in one or more of the following: C, C++, C#/Java, .NET, Python, Object-Oriented Programming, CI/CD tools, scripting tools, and DevOps.
1+ Years of experience in containers, serverless, streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, etc.), distributed systems design (SOA/microservices) concepts, and capabilities.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain trade-offs and walk others through technical decisions clearly.
Ability to work across competing and alternating priorities while staying focused on timely delivery.
Preferred Requirements:
1+ Years of experience building data engineering pipelines with MPP databases (e.g., AWS RedShift, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, Teradata), Lambda architecture design, database design, data modeling, Big Data Cloud (e.g., SPARK, Splunk, NoSQL), advanced analytics, and AI/ML infrastructure solutions.
2+ Years of experience in large-scale software development and integration, especially in Big Data/AI/ML.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a track record of meeting and beating commitments.
Systematic problem-solving approach and tolerance for ambiguity.
